description: Use to look at one data-library dataset (`dataset_id` from list_datasets) before querying or reusing it. Returns its name, description, visibility, citation, source link and licence (check the licence before reusing it), the projects it belongs to, the published version (number, state, source kind), and its layer with fields, types, source CRS, bounds and feature count. For a dataset the user owns it also returns the uploaded file's name, size and type and the import report. Pass the layer id to query_features.
name: describe_dataset
title: Describe a dataset
